items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: A trio with Sammy Aaron on bass?

ctx.x: Is there a... did you ever hear the band that Chet Roble had, which had the same instrumentation as Noon, that is an aldo clarinet and rhythm section? Boyce Brown was the aldo player.
Oh, wait a minute. A trio with Sammy Aaron on bass? No, no, no, no, this is six pieces.
Oh. Had Eli Phillips on clarinet.
